## get the correlation time series
```{r warning = F, message=F}
vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc <- {}

for (t in 1:20) {
  coefs <- {}
  print(t)
  for (s in 1:120){
  df_ant_temp <- vrmid1_pupil_data%>%
  filter(probe == "anti",Time_sec == t, sample_in_sec == s)
  lm_ant_temp <- lmer(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(pupil_Avg_scaled) + (1|Subject) + (1|condition),df_ant_temp)
  lm_out <- c(summary(lm_ant_temp)$coefficient[2,],'r2m' = r.squaredGLMM(lm_ant_temp)[1])
  coefs <- rbind(coefs,lm_out)
  }
  coefs <- as.data.frame(coefs)%>%
    mutate(sample_in_sec = row_number(),
           Time_sec = t)
  rownames(coefs) <- NULL
  vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc <- rbind(vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc,coefs)
}

vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc <- vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc%>%
  mutate(sample_point = row_number())%>%
  rename(p_val = `Pr(>|t|)`) %>% 
  mutate(p_val_fdr = p.adjust(p_val, method = "fdr")) #applies the Benjamini–Hochberg correction

write.csv(vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc, "~/Desktop/VRMID-analysis/mid-pupil/data/vrmid1/derivatives/vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc.csv")
```

## make clusters
```{r}

# threshold and min cluster length
p_thresh <- 1e-3
mark_clusters <- function(df, p_thresh, min_cluster_length, merge_gap) {
  # df must contain columns: p_val_fdr and sample_in_sec (or any per-row index)
  # min_cluster_length and merge_gap are in SAMPLES (not seconds).
  
  # Ensure ordering and create sample index (1..N)
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(Time_sec, sample_in_sec) %>%
    mutate(.row_idx = seq_len(n()))
  
  # Logical vector: below threshold
  below <- df$p_val_fdr < p_thresh
  
  # Identify runs of TRUE / FALSE using rle
  r <- rle(below)
  lens <- r$lengths
  vals <- r$values
  ends <- cumsum(lens)
  starts <- ends - lens + 1
  runs <- tibble(
    run_id = seq_along(lens),
    start_idx = starts,
    end_idx = ends,
    length = lens,
    is_true = vals
  )
  
  # Keep only TRUE runs (candidate significant clusters)
  true_runs <- runs %>% filter(is_true)
  
  if (nrow(true_runs) == 0) {
    df$sig_cluster <- NA
    return(df %>% select(-.row_idx))
  }
  
  # Compute gaps between consecutive TRUE runs
  true_runs <- true_runs %>%
    arrange(start_idx) %>%
    mutate(
      prev_end = lag(end_idx),
      gap = if_else(is.na(prev_end), NA, start_idx - prev_end - 1L)
    )
  
  # start new merge group whenever gap > merge_gap or NA
  true_runs <- true_runs %>%
    mutate(new_group = cumsum(if_else(is.na(gap) | gap > merge_gap, 1L, 0L)))
  
  # Summarize merged groups
  merged <- true_runs %>%
    group_by(new_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_idx = first(start_idx),
      end_idx = last(end_idx),
      size = sum(length),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(size >= min_cluster_length)
  
  # If no merged cluster passes min length, return NA sig_cluster
  if (nrow(merged) == 0) {
    df$sig_cluster <- NA
    return(df %>% select(-.row_idx))
  }
  
  # Create logical mask of significant samples
  sig_mask <- rep(FALSE, nrow(df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(merged))) {
    si <- merged$start_idx[i]
    ei <- merged$end_idx[i]
    si <- max(1L, as.integer(si))
    ei <- min(nrow(df), as.integer(ei))
    sig_mask[si:ei] <- TRUE
  }
  
  # Assign sig_cluster column (1 = significant, NA = not)
  df$sig_cluster <- ifelse(sig_mask, 1L, NA)
  
  # Drop helper column and return
  df <- df %>% select(-.row_idx)
  return(df)
}



min_cluster_length <- 1 * 120  # 1s
merge_gap <- 0.3 * 120          # 0.1s

# Apply to all datasets
vrmid1_regression_coefs_out_nobc <- mark_clusters(vrmid1_regression_coefs_out_nobc, p_thresh, min_cluster_length,merge_gap)
vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc <- mark_clusters(vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc, p_thresh, min_cluster_length,merge_gap)

min_cluster_length <- 1 * 200  # 0.5s * 200 samples/sec = 100 samples
merge_gap <- 0.3 * 200          # 0.1s * 200 samples/sec = 20 samples
fmri3_regression_coefs_ant_nobc  <- mark_clusters(fmri3_regression_coefs_ant_nobc,  p_thresh, min_cluster_length,merge_gap)
fmri3_regression_coefs_out_nobc  <- mark_clusters(fmri3_regression_coefs_out_nobc,  p_thresh, min_cluster_length,merge_gap)
```

```{r warning = F, message=F}
vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc_ind <- {}

for (sub in unique(vrmid1_pupil_data$Subject)){
  print(sub)
  for (t in 1:20) {
  coefs <- {}
  for (s in 1:120){
  df_ant_temp <- vrmid1_pupil_data%>%
  filter(probe == "anti",Time_sec == t, sample_in_sec == s,
         Subject == sub)
  lm_ant_temp <- lmer(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(pupil_Avg_scaled) + (1|condition),df_ant_temp)
  lm_out <- c(summary(lm_ant_temp)$coefficient[2,],'r2m' = r.squaredGLMM(lm_ant_temp)[1])
  coefs <- rbind(coefs,lm_out)
  }
  coefs <- as.data.frame(coefs)%>%
    mutate(sample_in_sec = row_number(),
           Time_sec = t)
  rownames(coefs) <- NULL
  vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc_ind <- rbind(vrmid1_regression_coefs_ant_nobc_ind,coefs)
}
}
```
